title: VipPlanResult
description: vip.plan-result@1: answers about one plan on OpenVibe.VIP (vip.plan.create, vip.plan.update, vip.plan.archive). POST /api/v1/plans (201) and POST /api/v1/plans/:id/archive → { plan }; PATCH /api/v1/plans/:id → { plan, version, unchanged } (version: the version written, or the latest when unchanged); POST /api/v1/plans/:id/publish → { plan, replay } (replay: it was already published). The plan carries its creator.
